architecture: Dedicated versioned tool/resource and bundled probe keep existing fixed/discovery players unchanged. BroadcastChannel and exclusive Web Lock are appropriate to investigate actual host scope without adding server coordination. Manual comparison of both logs remains necessary.
complexity: Small standalone diagnostic is proportionate. Fix cancellation using a retained AbortController/attempt guard and distinguish local self-lock contention without building the full ownership feature.
correctness: Normal two-frame nonce, contention, release, and transfer paths pass local tests. Pause does not cancel pending acquisition, and self-contention can be presented as shared exclusion; reproduced independently against built candidate bundle.

findings.evidence: Independent repro: A holds; B clicks transfer and immediately Pause/release; after two ticks B audio.playCalls is 1 (expected 0). /tmp/dial-003-review-test.mjs first test.
findings.problem: Pause/release clears only an already-held lock. Its pending AbortController is private to requestLock and no invalidation guard protects callback/play continuation. A queued transfer still acquires and starts audio after user Pause; pagehide uses the same incomplete stop path.
findings.requested_change: Retain/cancel pending lock requests on Stop and pagehide; invalidate stale transfer callbacks/play continuations so they cannot restart audio or overwrite stopped state. Add focused regression coverage.

findings.evidence: Independent repro closes B, holds lock in A, clicks Check lock contention in A; displayed status is Lock blocked by another holder. Shared exclusion observed. /tmp/dial-003-review-test.mjs second test.
findings.problem: Check contention is allowed in the frame currently holding the lock. Its own lock causes acquired=false, but UI declares Another holder and Shared exclusion observed and records an observed exclusion check. This creates misleading positive evidence with only one frame.
findings.requested_change: Reject or label self-contention when local frame holds/requests the lock, and phrase raw contention as requiring corroboration from the other known holder/log. Do not promote this local self-check to observed shared exclusion. Add singleton/self-holder regression coverage.

requirements: Reviewed approved PRODUCT.md and TECH.md and exact seven-file candidate. Scope correctly stops at instrumented host probe; full cross-thread feature and actual host capability remain BLOCKED. Probe has two correctness/evidence-UX defects to fix before owner testing.
security: No added network coordinator or widened CSP; probe permits only existing Radio Paradise media origin and empty connectDomains. Messages are version/type checked, no stream URLs broadcast. Logs expose browser/frame location intentionally to tester; actual sharing remains manual.
